params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch correctly replaces the insecure default AES encryption mode (ECB) with the recommended AES/GCM/NoPadding mode, which provides both confidentiality and integrity. It properly handles IV generation, prepends the IV to the ciphertext for decryption, and uses GCMParameterSpec for initialization, addressing the SonarQube warning fully. All changes are directly related to fixing the warning, with no unrelated or unnecessary modifications.
